```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

checkcounters -> errorsfound
errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
errorsfound -> escalate "no"
clearcounters -> monitor
```

Notes on the authoring choices:

- Genre is `flowchart`, which per the router is dispatchable at `figdown 0.1` (no version bump needed, just the EXPERIMENTAL withdrawal risk noted here for the record).
- `errorsfound` is the sole decision node, with its two outgoing edges carrying the branch labels `"yes"` and `"no"` rather than baking the branch meaning into node labels — keeps the decision reusable and the labels short per the mode-3 guidance.
- `monitor` and `escalate` are both `terminator` nodes since each ends its path (monitoring vs. escalation), matching the request that they be terminators.
